captions.text: Coere builds a memory from Maya’s chats, with her own keys.
Nothing goes to an AI until she presses Build my memory.
Coere reads her chats and the graph grows, section by section.
The Memory page draws everything as one graph, with Maya in the middle and a section for each part of her life.
Each memory sits beside the chats it came from, the small dots around it.
All shows both. Memories shows only what Coere learned.
Chats shows only the chats, each round the thing it taught.
A click opens a section, with its folders, memories and chats.
Search lists the top four matches and lights them on the graph.
Every memory keeps the chat and the words it came from.
